primitives.name: Promotions Compliance Data Model
primitives.verbatim_quote: # Final Decision Matrix As of: 2026-06-09 ## P0 BUILD NOW - BUILD-GV2-001: Promotions compliance data
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'R_{comply}': 'dimensionless risk score for compliance', 'D_{promo}': 'discrete promotion identifier', 'S_{state}': 'state-space vector of jurisdictional rules'}
primitives.assumptions: Compliance is modeled as a binary predicate over jurisdictional constraints and promotion metadata.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When S_{state} is undefined or D_{promo} lacks metadata.

layer2.mapping: GSI's Bayesian update on R_{comply} mirrors GSE's state transition on D_{promo} under S_{state}.
layer2.telemetry: Observed compliance rate vs expected under prior.

primitives.name: No-Bet Radar Public Teaser
primitives.verbatim_quote: - BUILD-GV2-012: PRO to ELITE decision-quality upgrade path (EXTENSION) - BUILD-GV2-017: No-bet radar public teaser (NET_NEW)
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'B_{bet}': 'binary bet status', 'F_{flag}': 'flag indicating risk exposure', 'M_{model}': 'predictive model confidence score'}

layer2.telemetry: Frequency of teaser appearance per user session.

The 'Promotions Compliance Data' acts as a prior over jurisdictional risks, which GSE uses to gate access to offers. The 'Responsible Play Offer Card' introduces a stochastic element in user behavior prediction, while the 'No-Bet Radar Teaser' provides a feedback mechanism to prevent high-risk actions. These operators are dual in structure: GSI infers risk from data, GSE mitigates it via policy. Failure modes arise when jurisdictional data is stale or when user behavior deviates from modeled distributions. The system enforces a causal closure between data, inference, and action.
